summary: InfraStatisticsDisplay (canary), GestureDevice, UnderfloorHeatingController and DoorbellReceiver each run the aac-tools toolchain's arch-validate in Jenkinsfile.architecture and their lint gate, their copies are deleted, and each environment declares aac-tools (close-out A8). Each was pushed alone; its firmware build was green with a successful flash upload, its AaC build ran arch-validate in the aac-tools container, and the collector and site pin rolled (ledger rows committed). The root gate is green; the Ansible branch carries no commit.
